## AI Lead Management Assistant
Sorts every enquiry that reaches your inbox or website form: category, priority and a one-line summary, logged in Google Sheets, with a reply drafted in Gmail (in the same thread) for you to check and send. High-priority enquiries are emailed to the team.
1. Fill in **Settings**. 2. Make a sheet with an **Enquiries** tab (`enquiries-sheet.csv`). 3. Connect Gmail, Google Sheets and OpenAI. 4. Activate.
